name: Eyem Iconic
consignor: Marty Powers, Agent for J Lazy Six Ranch
sire: By ONE FAMOUS ICON SI 103 (2016). 4 wins, $46,890. Brother to ONE FAMOUS EAGLE SI 101 (Champion). Half-brother to FAMOUS CARTEL LADY SI 107. Sire of Rcaintshefamous SI 87 (3 wins, $31,885), Master Of The Craft SI 94 (winner, $23,064), One Cache Icon SI 90 (winner, $17,236), Jess Icon SI 84 (winner, $15,599), Miss Famous Icon SI 85 (winner, $13,950), RP Pretty Woman SI 90 (winner). Son of champion MR JESS PERRY SI 113; sire of 168 stakes winners and 9 champions.
